control_transport: Temporary BLE native A4 scene/index probes; no claim of native Wi-Fi support
method: Peak connected component above80%of red(R-max(G,B)) or blue/cyan(max(G,B)-R) chroma, in predeclared panel/ring elliptical ROI. Original photos unmodified and withheld.
scope: Optical response centroids from one viewing position, not PCB/physical LED coordinates. Group boundaries tested separately; within-group angular order is measured, not assumed.

ring.scope: Separate descriptive fit to measured points; raw fixed-ROI centroids remain unchanged.

panel_outer.scope: Separate descriptive fit to measured points; raw fixed-ROI centroids remain unchanged.

panel_next.scope: Separate descriptive fit to measured points; raw fixed-ROI centroids remain unchanged.

panel_inner.scope: Separate descriptive fit to measured points; raw fixed-ROI centroids remain unchanged.

panel_innermost.scope: Separate descriptive fit to measured points; raw fixed-ROI centroids remain unchanged.

closest_red_centroid_pair.scope: Optical resolution check; not a physical LED separation measurement
